kept_lines: Online Bookkeeping Pricing | Acuity's Customizable Solutions
Meet the demands of banks, boards, and investors with GAAP-compliant financials and dedicated CFO support.

"We've been with Acuity for four years. We started off with basic bookkeeping and have added more services since then. Working with Acuity has: 1) Given me time back so that I can focus on growing the business. 2) Helped me better present to investors. 3) Given me peace of mind. Our financial planning has produced a lot of predictability."

"Acuity was affordable when we were bootstrapped and needed some help, but they've also been able to scale with us as we've grown. We've used them for ongoing bookkeeping, but we also worked with one of their CFOs to help us build a financial model to present to investors when we were raising our Series A."
